source.title: Oklahoma Open 2019 on January 12, 2019 in Lawton, Oklahoma, United States
source.content: The [Oklahoma Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OklahomaOpen2019) will take place on January 12, 2019 in Lawton, Oklahoma, United States. Check out [Oklahoma Open 2019 website](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OklahomaOpen2019) for more information and registration.

translation.title: Oklahoma Open 2019 将于 2019 年 1 月 12 日在美国俄克拉荷马州劳顿举行
